description: This file provides a utility function for transforming text descriptions into React elements with clickable links, specifically recognizing web URLs and rendering them as anchor tags.

methods.name: linkifyText
methods.description: Transforms a string by detecting web URLs and rendering them as clickable links within an array of React elements.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Creates an <a> React element for a given text, prepending 'https://' if the text starts with 'www.'.
